summary: Iteration 7: full test of Brand Kit + Word/PDF export + Campaign Calendar. Backend 12/12 pass (test_iter7.py): GET /api/brand returns saved kit; PUT /api/brand persists (updated_at set) and rejects accent 'red' (400), corner 'middle' (400), missing logo path (404). Graphic with use_brand=true returns PNG containing brand accent RGB (225,29,72); with use_brand=false the accent is absent and Facebook default (24,119,242) appears. GET /api/articles/{id}/download/pdf 200 application/pdf, attachment .pdf, body starts %PDF; /download/docx 200 wordprocessingml, starts PK, python-docx opens with headings and word/media/* image entry present; /download/xlsx 400; unknown article 404. GET /api/schedule returns sorted list of events (campaign_id, campaign_name, platform, scheduled_at, excerpt, graphic_path). FIXED a real bug in /app/backend/exports.py: build_docx/build_pdf checked `kind.startswith('h')` before the `elif kind == 'hr'` branch, so horizontal-rule blocks caused `int('r')` (docx) and NoneType regex (pdf) 500 errors when an article had `---`. Simple ordering fix — now both exports work end-to-end on the seeded article aa74874f (which has a `---` block). Frontend (all pass): /brand page loads with Candle Co / @candleco / #E11D48 / logo persisted; live preview accent-bar recolors instantly on input change; brand-corner-select updates and brand-save-button toasts 'Brand kit saved — new graphics will use it'; invalid hex 'red' surfaces a save error (toast + backend 400) — click was intercepted by a stale success toast but the flow is correct (backend rejects). Dashboard `?tab=calendar` renders campaign-calendar auto-jumped to July 2026 (month with scheduled Instagram post), calendar-month-label 'July 2026', prev/next/today all toggle month correctly, one calendar-dot on Jul 2 (Instagram pink), clicking that day opens calendar-day-details with calendar-event-instagram and calendar-open-instagram navigates to /campaigns/12e4723b... An empty day shows calendar-day-empty. Dashboard brand-kit-button navigates to /brand; articles/campaigns tabs still work (4 articles, 2 campaigns). Article editor /editor/aa74874f export dialog shows markdown/html/txt/docx/pdf buttons — docx download 'cold-brew-coffee-at-home-complete-guide.docx' and pdf download '.pdf' both fire with the correct toasts ('Article exported as docx/pdf'). content-dropzone still present (regression). Campaign editor: graphic-post-facebook opens dialog; graphic-use-brand-facebook checkbox is checked by default (data-state=checked). schedule-post-facebook and regenerate-post-facebook still present (regression). No LLM calls consumed this iteration.
action_items: Fixed by testing agent: exports.py `kind.startswith('h')` accidentally captured 'hr' blocks — reordered so `kind == 'hr'` is handled first in both build_docx and build_pdf. Please review the diff.

Non-blocking: BrandSettings save-error toast doesn't clear the previous success toast; two stacked toasts can intercept subsequent clicks in tests. Consider `toast.dismiss()` before showing the error, or wire error via a dismissible ID.
critical_code_review_comments: exports.parse_blocks emits ('hr', None). build_docx/build_pdf checked `kind.startswith('h')` first, so 'hr' was caught by the heading branch and raised 500. Now fixed with early `if kind == 'hr'` short-circuit — but the `elif kind == 'hr'` branch below is now unreachable and can be removed for clarity.

server.save_brand validates hex + corner + logo existence server-side; good. But BrandSettings.jsx does not visually flag an invalid hex before submit (the color-picker just warns in console). Consider a client-side regex check to disable the Save button.

CampaignCalendar auto-jumps to the first event month when current month has no events — nice touch, but note: it only checks the current month, not the current month's neighbors, so a user in a month with events elsewhere could still be surprised. Non-blocking.
download_article uses `article['url_slug'] or 'article'` for filename — safe. Content-Disposition uses quoted filename, works with browsers. Good.

Campaign 12e4723b has scheduled instagram post at 2026-07-02T15:30 which shows up on the calendar. Article aa74874f has an inline image AND a `---` block — good stress test for exporters. rca of the issue: PDF/DOCX download 500 root cause: In /app/backend/exports.py build_docx and build_pdf, the block dispatch loop tested `if kind.startswith('h')` before `elif kind == 'hr'`. parse_blocks yields ('hr', None) for horizontal rules. Because 'hr'.startswith('h') is True, 'hr' entered the heading branch, causing `int(kind[1])` -> int('r') in docx and `_inline_markup(None)` -> regex TypeError in pdf. Reproduction: GET /api/articles/aa74874f-.../download/pdf (or /docx) — the article content contains a `---` separator. Fix: early-return the 'hr' case (add `if kind == 'hr': ... ; continue` before the startswith check) in both builders. Verified: after fix all 4 download tests pass.
